paragraphs.en: Amid a reported 400 job cuts, the legendary studio is closing.
paragraphs.zh: 据报道在裁员400人的背景下，这家传奇工作室即将关闭。

paragraphs.en: BioWare, the legendary studio behind RPGs like Mass Effect , Dragon Age , and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic , is shutting down, the company confirmed in a statement . Alongside the closure, Electronic Arts has chosen not to continue development on the next Mass Effect game that was in the works, according to an announcement sent to EA staff .
paragraphs.zh: 以《质量效应》《龙腾世纪》《星球大战：旧共和国武士》等角色扮演游戏闻名的传奇工作室BioWare即将关闭，该公司在一份声明中证实了这一消息。 根据一份发送给EA员工的公告，在工作室关闭的同时，Electronic Arts已决定不再继续开发正在制作中的下一款《质量效应》游戏。

sents.en: BioWare, the legendary studio behind RPGs like Mass Effect , Dragon Age , and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic , is shutting down, the company confirmed in a statement .
sents.zh: 以《质量效应》《龙腾世纪》《星球大战：旧共和国武士》等角色扮演游戏闻名的传奇工作室BioWare即将关闭，该公司在一份声明中证实了这一消息。

sents.en: Alongside the closure, Electronic Arts has chosen not to continue development on the next Mass Effect game that was in the works, according to an announcement sent to EA staff .
sents.zh: 根据一份发送给EA员工的公告，在工作室关闭的同时，Electronic Arts已决定不再继续开发正在制作中的下一款《质量效应》游戏。

paragraphs.en: The company is also laying off around 400 staffers, Bloomberg reports , including around 50 at BioWare. The changes follow EA being taken private by an investor group led by Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners in a $55 billion deal that closed in August . Other major gaming companies have made sweeping changes this year as well, including Xbox’s “reset” that will include 3,200 cuts , Bungie’s “significant” layoffs , and Fortnite maker Epic Games laying off over 1,000 staff .
paragraphs.zh: 据彭博社报道，该公司还将裁减约 400 名员工，其中包括 BioWare 的约 50 人。 这些变动发生在 EA 被一个由沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金、银湖和 Affinity Partners 牵头的投资财团以 550 亿美元的交易私有化之后，该交易已于今年 8 月完成。 其他大型游戏公司今年也做出了大规模调整，包括 Xbox 将裁员 3200 人的「重置」计划、Bungie 的「大规模」裁员，以及《堡垒之夜》开发商 Epic Games 裁减超过 1000 名员工。

sents.en: The company is also laying off around 400 staffers, Bloomberg reports , including around 50 at BioWare.
sents.zh: 据彭博社报道，该公司还将裁减约 400 名员工，其中包括 BioWare 的约 50 人。

sents.en: The changes follow EA being taken private by an investor group led by Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners in a $55 billion deal that closed in August .
sents.zh: 这些变动发生在 EA 被一个由沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金、银湖和 Affinity Partners 牵头的投资财团以 550 亿美元的交易私有化之后，该交易已于今年 8 月完成。

sents.en: Other major gaming companies have made sweeping changes this year as well, including Xbox’s “reset” that will include 3,200 cuts , Bungie’s “significant” layoffs , and Fortnite maker Epic Games laying off over 1,000 staff .
sents.zh: 其他大型游戏公司今年也做出了大规模调整，包括 Xbox 将裁员 3200 人的「重置」计划、Bungie 的「大规模」裁员，以及《堡垒之夜》开发商 Epic Games 裁减超过 1000 名员工。

paragraphs.en: “BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly,” Cam Weber, EA president and chief studios officer, and David Tinson, EA president and COO, said in the announcement.
paragraphs.zh: “BioWare 是一家传奇工作室，曾参与定义角色扮演游戏类型，我们对这一决定绝非轻率，”EA 总裁兼工作室事务首席官卡姆·韦伯（Cam Weber）与 EA 总裁兼首席运营官大卫·廷森（David Tinson）在公告中表示。

paragraphs.en: Here is the full message that BioWare shared on social media:
paragraphs.zh: 以下是 BioWare 在社交媒体上分享的完整消息：

paragraphs.en: For more than 30 years, BioWare has been more than a studio. It has been a home for storytellers, developers, and the players who brought our worlds to life.
paragraphs.zh: 三十多年来，BioWare 不仅仅是一个工作室。 它一直是讲故事的人、开发者，以及让我们的世界变得鲜活的玩家们的家园。

sents.en: For more than 30 years, BioWare has been more than a studio.
sents.zh: 三十多年来，BioWare 不仅仅是一个工作室。

sents.en: It has been a home for storytellers, developers, and the players who brought our worlds to life.
sents.zh: 它一直是讲故事的人、开发者，以及让我们的世界变得鲜活的玩家们的家园。

paragraphs.en: Baldur’s Gate. Neverwinter Nights. Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic. Dragon Age. Mass Effect. Anthem.
paragraphs.zh: 博德之门。无冬之夜。 星球大战：旧共和国武士。龙腾世纪。质量效应。圣歌。

sents.en: Baldur’s Gate. Neverwinter Nights.
sents.zh: 博德之门。无冬之夜。

sents.en: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic. Dragon Age. Mass Effect. Anthem.
sents.zh: 星球大战：旧共和国武士。龙腾世纪。质量效应。圣歌。

paragraphs.en: Now, after more than three decades of shared adventures, BioWare is closing and early development on the next Mass Effect project is ending.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，在共同经历了三十多年的冒险之后，BioWare 即将关闭，下一个《质量效应》项目的早期开发也随之终结。

paragraphs.en: There is nothing easy about writing those words. Our focus right now is on our incredibly talented team who put their hearts into these games, and supporting one another through this transition.
paragraphs.zh: 写下这些话绝非易事。 我们现在关注的是我们这支才华横溢的团队，他们为这些游戏倾注了心血，我们要在这段过渡期中相互支持。

sents.en: There is nothing easy about writing those words.
sents.zh: 写下这些话绝非易事。

sents.en: Our focus right now is on our incredibly talented team who put their hearts into these games, and supporting one another through this transition.
sents.zh: 我们现在关注的是我们这支才华横溢的团队，他们为这些游戏倾注了心血，我们要在这段过渡期中相互支持。

paragraphs.en: What generations of BioWare built together is something to celebrate and remember. These games became so much more because you played them, debated your choices, fell in love with the characters, and made these worlds your own.
paragraphs.zh: BioWare 一代又一代人共同打造的一切，值得我们庆祝与铭记。 这些游戏之所以变得如此意义非凡，是因为你们游玩过它们、讨论过自己的选择、爱上了其中的角色，并让这些世界成为了你们自己的世界。

sents.en: What generations of BioWare built together is something to celebrate and remember.
sents.zh: BioWare 一代又一代人共同打造的一切，值得我们庆祝与铭记。

sents.en: These games became so much more because you played them, debated your choices, fell in love with the characters, and made these worlds your own.
sents.zh: 这些游戏之所以变得如此意义非凡，是因为你们游玩过它们、讨论过自己的选择、爱上了其中的角色，并让这些世界成为了你们自己的世界。

paragraphs.en: From all of us at BioWare, thank you for being the most meaningful part of our story.
paragraphs.zh: 来自 BioWare 全体成员的感谢：感谢你们成为我们故事中最有意义的部分。

paragraphs.en: While the end of BioWare will shock many gamers who fondly remember its hits, the company hasn’t been as successful in recent years. 2017’s Mass Effect: Andromeda was widely seen as a misstep for that franchise, it took a big bet on live service games in 2019 with Anthem that didn’t pan out , and EA laid off some BioWare staff in 2025 after Dragon Age: The Veilguard missed sales expectations .
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 BioWare 的落幕会让许多怀念其经典作品的玩家感到震惊，但这家公司近年来并不顺利。2017 年的《质量效应：仙女座》被普遍视为该系列的失手之作，2019 年公司又在《圣歌》这款即时服务游戏上下了大注却未能如愿，而在《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》未达销售预期后，EA 于 2025 年裁撤了部分 BioWare 员工。

paragraphs.en: Initially, the fate of Amazon’s Mass Effect TV series was unclear. Amazon MGM Studios spokesperson Nate Kirtman declined to comment. EA spokesperson Justin Higgs said he had “Nothing to share on that at this point.” But Wednesday evening, IGN reported that the show is still in development.
paragraphs.zh: 起初，亚马逊旗下《质量效应》电视剧的命运尚不明朗。 亚马逊 MGM 工作室发言人 Nate Kirtman 拒绝置评。 EA 发言人 Justin Higgs 表示他「目前没有什么可分享的信息」。但在周三晚上，IGN 报道称该剧仍在开发中。

sents.en: Initially, the fate of Amazon’s Mass Effect TV series was unclear.
sents.zh: 起初，亚马逊旗下《质量效应》电视剧的命运尚不明朗。

sents.en: Amazon MGM Studios spokesperson Nate Kirtman declined to comment.
sents.zh: 亚马逊 MGM 工作室发言人 Nate Kirtman 拒绝置评。

sents.en: EA spokesperson Justin Higgs said he had “Nothing to share on that at this point.” But Wednesday evening, IGN reported that the show is still in development.
sents.zh: EA 发言人 Justin Higgs 表示他「目前没有什么可分享的信息」。但在周三晚上，IGN 报道称该剧仍在开发中。

paragraphs.en: In EA’s company-wide announcement, Weber and Tinson outlined several other projects in development and changes to EA’s roadmap. The executives say that Respawn and DICE will be collaborating on “a future project,” which Bloomberg says is “likely” a new Star Wars: Battlefront game. The company is still working Marvel’s Iron Man and a new Star Wars Jedi title. EA is making a “brand-new, social-first open-world experience” football game that it calls “Project Gridiron” and is also in pre-production on a new Fight Night boxing title ( which was teased yesterday ). For The Sims , the company is pausing development on “Project Lotus” and focusing on “Project Evergreen.” And for its live-service Skate , EA is “making changes to the studio” to “deliver on a very clear roadmap for our community.”
paragraphs.zh: 在EA的全公司公告中，Weber和Tinson介绍了其他几个正在开发的项目以及EA路线图的调整。 这两位高管表示，Respawn和DICE将合作开发“一个未来项目”，而据彭博社报道，该项目“很可能”是一款新的《星球大战：前线》游戏。 该公司仍在开发《漫威钢铁侠》和一款新的《星球大战 绝地》游戏。 EA正在开发一款名为“Gridiron计划”的“全新、社交优先的开放世界体验”橄榄球游戏，同时一款新的《搏击之夜》拳击游戏也已进入前期制作阶段（该作昨日已有所暗示）。 对于《模拟人生》，该公司将暂停“Lotus计划”的开发，转而专注于“Evergreen计划”。至于其持续运营的《Skate》，EA正在“对工作室进行调整”，以便“为我们的社区兑现一个非常清晰的路线图”。

sents.zh: 在EA的全公司公告中，Weber和Tinson介绍了其他几个正在开发的项目以及EA路线图的调整。

paragraphs.en: Here is the full message from Weber and Tinson at Electronic Arts:
paragraphs.zh: 以下是来自 Electronic Arts 的 Weber 和 Tinson 的完整消息：

paragraphs.en: Through every major moment we’ve faced as a company, your commitment to creating awesome games and experiences for our players continues to be impressive. Together, we’ve built epic worlds and global communities that are part of the lives of hundreds of millions of people.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们公司经历的每一个重大时刻中，你们始终致力于为玩家打造精彩的游戏和体验，这一点令人赞叹。 我们携手打造了宏大的世界和全球社区，它们已成为数亿人生活的一部分。

sents.en: Through every major moment we’ve faced as a company, your commitment to creating awesome games and experiences for our players continues to be impressive.
sents.zh: 在我们公司经历的每一个重大时刻中，你们始终致力于为玩家打造精彩的游戏和体验，这一点令人赞叹。

sents.en: Together, we’ve built epic worlds and global communities that are part of the lives of hundreds of millions of people.
sents.zh: 我们携手打造了宏大的世界和全球社区，它们已成为数亿人生活的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Today, we’re the number one publisher in Western HD gaming. That’s an extraordinary position to lead from, and one we should be proud of. Yet our industry is changing quickly. Players have more choices than ever for their time and attention, competition is intensifying, and some of our biggest opportunities for growth are beyond the markets, platforms, and business models where EA has traditionally been the strongest.
paragraphs.zh: 今天，我们是西方高清游戏领域排名第一的发行商。 这是一个非凡的领先地位，值得我们为之自豪。 然而，我们的行业正在快速变化。 玩家在时间和注意力上面临的选择比以往任何时候都多，竞争日趋激烈，而我们一些最大的增长机会正处于 EA 传统上并非最强的市场、平台和商业模式之外。

sents.en: Today, we’re the number one publisher in Western HD gaming.
sents.zh: 今天，我们是西方高清游戏领域排名第一的发行商。

sents.en: That’s an extraordinary position to lead from, and one we should be proud of.
sents.zh: 这是一个非凡的领先地位，值得我们为之自豪。

sents.en: Yet our industry is changing quickly.
sents.zh: 然而，我们的行业正在快速变化。

sents.en: Players have more choices than ever for their time and attention, competition is intensifying, and some of our biggest opportunities for growth are beyond the markets, platforms, and business models where EA has traditionally been the strongest.
sents.zh: 玩家在时间和注意力上面临的选择比以往任何时候都多，竞争日趋激烈，而我们一些最大的增长机会正处于 EA 传统上并非最强的市场、平台和商业模式之外。

paragraphs.en: That’s why, over the past several months, we’ve taken a hard look at our business, how we operate, and what it will take to lead in this next era of interactive entertainment. We’ve challenged assumptions, confronted hard realities, imagined new possibilities, and made deliberate choices in order to deliver exceptional experiences for our players and to drive sustained growth.
paragraphs.zh: 正因如此，在过去几个月里，我们对自己的业务、运营方式，以及要在这个互动娱乐新时代中保持领先所需具备的条件，进行了深入的审视。 我们挑战了固有假设，正视了严峻的现实，设想了新的可能性，并做出了审慎的选择，以便为我们的玩家带来卓越的体验，并推动可持续的增长。

sents.en: That’s why, over the past several months, we’ve taken a hard look at our business, how we operate, and what it will take to lead in this next era of interactive entertainment.
sents.zh: 正因如此，在过去几个月里，我们对自己的业务、运营方式，以及要在这个互动娱乐新时代中保持领先所需具备的条件，进行了深入的审视。

sents.en: We’ve challenged assumptions, confronted hard realities, imagined new possibilities, and made deliberate choices in order to deliver exceptional experiences for our players and to drive sustained growth.
sents.zh: 我们挑战了固有假设，正视了严峻的现实，设想了新的可能性，并做出了审慎的选择，以便为我们的玩家带来卓越的体验，并推动可持续的增长。

paragraphs.en: We believe our best creative work happens when we’re clear about what matters most for our players and give our teams the freedom to move quickly. So, we’re concentrating our teams, technology, and investment behind these three strategic priorities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们相信，当我们清楚地知道对玩家而言什么最重要，并给予团队快速行动的自由时，我们才能做出最好的创意作品。 因此，我们将团队、技术和投资集中投入到这三项战略重点之中。

sents.en: We believe our best creative work happens when we’re clear about what matters most for our players and give our teams the freedom to move quickly.
sents.zh: 我们相信，当我们清楚地知道对玩家而言什么最重要，并给予团队快速行动的自由时，我们才能做出最好的创意作品。

sents.en: So, we’re concentrating our teams, technology, and investment behind these three strategic priorities.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将团队、技术和投资集中投入到这三项战略重点之中。

paragraphs.en: These priorities will bring clarity and focus to your work every day, and so will the way we work. We’ve spent time listening to teams about what’s working, what’s getting in the way, and what you need to do your best work. The feedback was consistent: you want clearer priorities, faster decisions, and teams that work more closely together. We’ve already begun simplifying how we work so we can spend more time creating and innovating for our players.
paragraphs.zh: 这些优先事项将让你每天的工作更加清晰和专注，我们的工作方式也是如此。 我们花时间倾听了各个团队的意见，了解哪些做法有效、哪些存在阻碍，以及你们需要什么才能发挥最佳水平。 反馈是一致的：你们希望有更清晰的优先事项、更快的决策，以及协作更紧密的团队。 我们已经开始简化工作方式，以便能投入更多时间为玩家进行创造和创新。

sents.en: These priorities will bring clarity and focus to your work every day, and so will the way we work.
sents.zh: 这些优先事项将让你每天的工作更加清晰和专注，我们的工作方式也是如此。

sents.en: We’ve spent time listening to teams about what’s working, what’s getting in the way, and what you need to do your best work.
sents.zh: 我们花时间倾听了各个团队的意见，了解哪些做法有效、哪些存在阻碍，以及你们需要什么才能发挥最佳水平。

sents.en: The feedback was consistent: you want clearer priorities, faster decisions, and teams that work more closely together.
sents.zh: 反馈是一致的：你们希望有更清晰的优先事项、更快的决策，以及协作更紧密的团队。

sents.en: We’ve already begun simplifying how we work so we can spend more time creating and innovating for our players.
sents.zh: 我们已经开始简化工作方式，以便能投入更多时间为玩家进行创造和创新。

paragraphs.en: Across our portfolio, we’re making deliberate choices to align talent and investments where we see the greatest opportunities for players and long-term growth.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们整个产品组合中，我们正在做出审慎的选择，将人才和投资聚焦于我们认为能为玩家带来最大机遇并实现长期增长的领域。

paragraphs.en: In our Shooters business , Battlefield 6 was a great success, and we learned a lot from the launch and the live service. We’re going to take those learnings, balance our resources, and leverage the technology to deliver a shooter portfolio that unlocks growth. In addition to our future Battlefield titles, we’ll be bringing together our Respawn and DICE studios to collaborate on a future project that will help us achieve that ambition. We can’t wait to share more when the time comes. We’re also continuing to invest heavily in Apex over the next few years by introducing brand new gameplay modes in multiplayer, and other new experiences, to expand the universe.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的射击游戏业务中，《战地6》取得了巨大成功，我们从发售和线上服务中学到了很多。 我们将运用这些经验，平衡资源，并利用技术打造一个能释放增长的射击游戏组合。 除了未来的《战地》系列作品外，我们还将把 Respawn 和 DICE 两个工作室联合起来，共同开发一个未来项目，帮助我们实现这一目标。 时机成熟时，我们迫不及待地想分享更多信息。 在未来几年，我们还将继续大力投资《Apex 英雄》，通过在多人模式中引入全新的玩法模式以及其他新体验，来扩展这个宇宙。

sents.en: In our Shooters business , Battlefield 6 was a great success, and we learned a lot from the launch and the live service.
sents.zh: 在我们的射击游戏业务中，《战地6》取得了巨大成功，我们从发售和线上服务中学到了很多。

sents.en: We’re going to take those learnings, balance our resources, and leverage the technology to deliver a shooter portfolio that unlocks growth.
sents.zh: 我们将运用这些经验，平衡资源，并利用技术打造一个能释放增长的射击游戏组合。

sents.en: In addition to our future Battlefield titles, we’ll be bringing together our Respawn and DICE studios to collaborate on a future project that will help us achieve that ambition.
sents.zh: 除了未来的《战地》系列作品外，我们还将把 Respawn 和 DICE 两个工作室联合起来，共同开发一个未来项目，帮助我们实现这一目标。

sents.en: We can’t wait to share more when the time comes.
sents.zh: 时机成熟时，我们迫不及待地想分享更多信息。

sents.en: We’re also continuing to invest heavily in Apex over the next few years by introducing brand new gameplay modes in multiplayer, and other new experiences, to expand the universe.
sents.zh: 在未来几年，我们还将继续大力投资《Apex 英雄》，通过在多人模式中引入全新的玩法模式以及其他新体验，来扩展这个宇宙。

paragraphs.en: Action-adventure is one of the most competitive and high-stakes genres in the industry, where every game needs our full weight behind it. We’re continuing to deliver on our two huge launches coming up with Marvel’s Iron Man and the next Star Wars Jedi game. Beyond that, we will concentrate our efforts on fewer simultaneous, large-scale projects, ensuring that every game we build in this space is fully set up for success.
paragraphs.zh: 动作冒险是该行业竞争最激烈、风险最高的品类之一，这里的每一款游戏都需要我们全力以赴。 我们将继续推进即将推出的两款重磅作品：《漫威钢铁侠》和下一款《星球大战 绝地》游戏。 除此之外，我们将把精力集中在更少数并行的大型项目上，确保我们在这个领域打造的每一款游戏都为成功做好充分准备。

sents.en: Action-adventure is one of the most competitive and high-stakes genres in the industry, where every game needs our full weight behind it.
sents.zh: 动作冒险是该行业竞争最激烈、风险最高的品类之一，这里的每一款游戏都需要我们全力以赴。

sents.en: We’re continuing to deliver on our two huge launches coming up with Marvel’s Iron Man and the next Star Wars Jedi game.
sents.zh: 我们将继续推进即将推出的两款重磅作品：《漫威钢铁侠》和下一款《星球大战 绝地》游戏。

sents.en: Beyond that, we will concentrate our efforts on fewer simultaneous, large-scale projects, ensuring that every game we build in this space is fully set up for success.
sents.zh: 除此之外，我们将把精力集中在更少数并行的大型项目上，确保我们在这个领域打造的每一款游戏都为成功做好充分准备。

paragraphs.en: As we focus on these larger opportunities, we’ve had a small team at BioWare working on early-development for Mass Effect. We’ve made the decision not to move forward with this development, which means we’re closing the studio and our Edmonton workspace. BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们聚焦这些更重大的机遇之际，BioWare 有一支小团队一直在进行《质量效应》的早期开发。 我们已决定不再继续推进这项开发，这意味着我们将关闭工作室以及我们在埃德蒙顿的办公场所。 BioWare 是一家传奇工作室，曾帮助定义了角色扮演游戏这一类型，我们对这个决定并不轻率。

sents.en: As we focus on these larger opportunities, we’ve had a small team at BioWare working on early-development for Mass Effect.
sents.zh: 在我们聚焦这些更重大的机遇之际，BioWare 有一支小团队一直在进行《质量效应》的早期开发。

sents.en: We’ve made the decision not to move forward with this development, which means we’re closing the studio and our Edmonton workspace.
sents.zh: 我们已决定不再继续推进这项开发，这意味着我们将关闭工作室以及我们在埃德蒙顿的办公场所。

sents.en: BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly.
sents.zh: BioWare 是一家传奇工作室，曾帮助定义了角色扮演游戏这一类型，我们对这个决定并不轻率。

paragraphs.en: EA SPORTS continues to operate from a position of strength. We are fully committed and investing in the global growth of our FC franchise and across the full EA SPORTS portfolio. We have two new projects in development you’ll hear about over the next few months, including a brand-new, social-first open-world experience for our American Football team that we call “Project Gridiron,” and we are also in pre-production to bring back a beloved, fan-favorite in Fight Night, leveraging capabilities from our simulation fighting team.
paragraphs.zh: EA SPORTS 继续保持强势地位运营。 我们将全力以赴，持续投资 FC 系列及整个 EA SPORTS 产品组合的全球增长。 我们有两个新项目正在开发中，你将在未来几个月内陆续听到相关消息，其中包括一个全新的、以社交为先的橄榄球开放世界体验，我们称之为“Project Gridiron”；此外，我们还在预制作阶段，借助模拟格斗团队的技术能力，让广受粉丝喜爱的经典之作《搏击之夜》回归。

sents.en: EA SPORTS continues to operate from a position of strength.
sents.zh: EA SPORTS 继续保持强势地位运营。

sents.en: We are fully committed and investing in the global growth of our FC franchise and across the full EA SPORTS portfolio.
sents.zh: 我们将全力以赴，持续投资 FC 系列及整个 EA SPORTS 产品组合的全球增长。

sents.en: We have two new projects in development you’ll hear about over the next few months, including a brand-new, social-first open-world experience for our American Football team that we call “Project Gridiron,” and we are also in pre-production to bring back a beloved, fan-favorite in Fight Night, leveraging capabilities from our simulation fighting team.
sents.zh: 我们有两个新项目正在开发中，你将在未来几个月内陆续听到相关消息，其中包括一个全新的、以社交为先的橄榄球开放世界体验，我们称之为“Project Gridiron”；此外，我们还在预制作阶段，借助模拟格斗团队的技术能力，让广受粉丝喜爱的经典之作《搏击之夜》回归。

paragraphs.en: In Lifestyle , we’re focusing on the long-term potential of The Sims and skate. We’re going to prioritize our efforts on “Project Evergreen” for The Sims to give the team more time to reach the full potential and vision for the game, and to help make this possible, we’re pausing development on “Project Lotus.” For skate., we’ve had a lot of success in bringing players into the game, and we need to create an experience that keeps them engaged over the long-term. To do that, we are making changes to the studio to have a more focused, smaller team to deliver on a very clear roadmap for our community that we believe will build a healthier and more sustainable business.
paragraphs.zh: 在生活方式（Lifestyle）业务领域，我们正专注于《模拟人生》（The Sims）和 skate. 的长期潜力。 我们将把精力优先投入《模拟人生》的「常青计划」（Project Evergreen），给团队更多时间来实现这款游戏的全部潜力和愿景；为了实现这一点，我们将暂停「莲花计划」（Project Lotus）的开发。对于 skate.，我们在吸引玩家进入游戏方面取得了很大成功，接下来我们需要打造一种能让玩家长期保持参与感的体验。 为此，我们正在对工作室进行调整，组建一个更加专注、规模更小的团队，为我们的社区交付一个非常明确的路线图，我们相信这将打造出更健康、更可持续的业务。

sents.en: In Lifestyle , we’re focusing on the long-term potential of The Sims and skate.
sents.zh: 在生活方式（Lifestyle）业务领域，我们正专注于《模拟人生》（The Sims）和 skate. 的长期潜力。

sents.en: We’re going to prioritize our efforts on “Project Evergreen” for The Sims to give the team more time to reach the full potential and vision for the game, and to help make this possible, we’re pausing development on “Project Lotus.” For skate., we’ve had a lot of success in bringing players into the game, and we need to create an experience that keeps them engaged over the long-term.
sents.zh: 我们将把精力优先投入《模拟人生》的「常青计划」（Project Evergreen），给团队更多时间来实现这款游戏的全部潜力和愿景；为了实现这一点，我们将暂停「莲花计划」（Project Lotus）的开发。对于 skate.，我们在吸引玩家进入游戏方面取得了很大成功，接下来我们需要打造一种能让玩家长期保持参与感的体验。

sents.en: To do that, we are making changes to the studio to have a more focused, smaller team to deliver on a very clear roadmap for our community that we believe will build a healthier and more sustainable business.
sents.zh: 为此，我们正在对工作室进行调整，组建一个更加专注、规模更小的团队，为我们的社区交付一个非常明确的路线图，我们相信这将打造出更健康、更可持续的业务。

paragraphs.en: The decisions we’re making in our priorities, how we work, and with our portfolio reflect our belief in EA’s future. Some open exciting new possibilities. Others are difficult, especially for the people and teams across the company who are directly affected. In those cases, we will support impacted employees in exploring other opportunities within EA, and we’re committed to treating impacted colleagues with care and respect.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在优先事项、工作方式以及产品组合方面所做的决策，体现了我们对EA未来的信心。 其中一些决策开启了令人振奋的新可能性。 另一些则是艰难的，尤其对公司内直接受影响的员工和团队而言。 在这些情况下，我们将支持受影响的员工在EA内部探索其他机会，并且我们承诺将以关怀和尊重对待受影响的同事。

sents.en: The decisions we’re making in our priorities, how we work, and with our portfolio reflect our belief in EA’s future.
sents.zh: 我们在优先事项、工作方式以及产品组合方面所做的决策，体现了我们对EA未来的信心。

sents.en: Some open exciting new possibilities.
sents.zh: 其中一些决策开启了令人振奋的新可能性。

sents.en: Others are difficult, especially for the people and teams across the company who are directly affected.
sents.zh: 另一些则是艰难的，尤其对公司内直接受影响的员工和团队而言。

sents.en: In those cases, we will support impacted employees in exploring other opportunities within EA, and we’re committed to treating impacted colleagues with care and respect.
sents.zh: 在这些情况下，我们将支持受影响的员工在EA内部探索其他机会，并且我们承诺将以关怀和尊重对待受影响的同事。

paragraphs.en: We’re sure there will be questions about what these changes mean for individual teams and for EA more broadly. You can speak directly with your leaders to hear more on that, and we’ll make sure to spend time discussing our direction and the work ahead at our next Global Town Hall in November.
paragraphs.zh: 我们确信，大家对于这些变化对各个团队以及更广泛地对 EA 意味着什么，会有许多疑问。 你可以直接与你的领导交流，进一步了解相关情况，我们也一定会在 11 月的下一次全球 Town Hall（全体员工大会）上花时间讨论我们的方向和接下来的工作。

sents.en: We’re sure there will be questions about what these changes mean for individual teams and for EA more broadly.
sents.zh: 我们确信，大家对于这些变化对各个团队以及更广泛地对 EA 意味着什么，会有许多疑问。

sents.en: You can speak directly with your leaders to hear more on that, and we’ll make sure to spend time discussing our direction and the work ahead at our next Global Town Hall in November.
sents.zh: 你可以直接与你的领导交流，进一步了解相关情况，我们也一定会在 11 月的下一次全球 Town Hall（全体员工大会）上花时间讨论我们的方向和接下来的工作。

paragraphs.en: The past several months have strengthened our belief in what EA can become. We have extraordinary people, franchises that matter to millions of players, and opportunities to build experiences we’ve only begun to imagine.
paragraphs.zh: 过去几个月的经历，进一步坚定了我们对于EA未来能够成为何种公司的信念。 我们拥有杰出的人才、对数百万玩家至关重要的系列作品，以及构建我们才刚刚开始想象的游戏体验的机会。

sents.en: The past several months have strengthened our belief in what EA can become.
sents.zh: 过去几个月的经历，进一步坚定了我们对于EA未来能够成为何种公司的信念。

sents.en: We have extraordinary people, franchises that matter to millions of players, and opportunities to build experiences we’ve only begun to imagine.
sents.zh: 我们拥有杰出的人才、对数百万玩家至关重要的系列作品，以及构建我们才刚刚开始想象的游戏体验的机会。

paragraphs.en: Our responsibility is to make the choices, provide the clarity, and create the conditions for our teams to do their best work. We also want to give every game we choose to build its best chance to succeed for our players and fans around the world.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的责任是做出选择、提供清晰的方向，并为我们的团队创造条件，让他们做到最出色的工作。 我们还希望让我们选择开发的每一款游戏都有最大的机会取得成功，服务我们世界各地的玩家和粉丝。

sents.en: Our responsibility is to make the choices, provide the clarity, and create the conditions for our teams to do their best work.
sents.zh: 我们的责任是做出选择、提供清晰的方向，并为我们的团队创造条件，让他们做到最出色的工作。

sents.en: We also want to give every game we choose to build its best chance to succeed for our players and fans around the world.
sents.zh: 我们还希望让我们选择开发的每一款游戏都有最大的机会取得成功，服务我们世界各地的玩家和粉丝。

paragraphs.en: We look forward to building more great games and experiences together.
paragraphs.zh: 我们期待与您携手打造更多精彩的游戏和体验。
